Hen Hotspot includes WinDivert 2.2.2, by basil and its contributors.
Project: https://reqrypt.org/windivert.html
Source: https://github.com/basil00/WinDivert/tree/v2.2.2

The unmodified x64 DLL and signed driver come from the official
WinDivert-2.2.2-A.zip distribution. WinDivert is distributed here under
GNU LGPL version 3 or later; see LICENSE for the complete license texts.
The corresponding source archive is included in this directory.
WinDivert remains a separate dynamic library; no WinDivert source changes
have been made. Its license and attribution are retained.

WinDivert is an independent project and is not a Microsoft product.
